clips.title: The story
paras: At Fel Rock, Melenas' Head marks the end of a lingering demonic threat on Teldrassil. Taken as a bounty from Lord Melenas, the satyr commander encamped there, it is proof of his death.

Satyrs on Teldrassil’s new World Tree shame the night elves who guard Shadowglen and the surrounding reaches. Lord Melenas made his lair in Fel Rock’s twisted caverns, just north of the elven settlements, and rallied aggressive grell warriors to his banner. The kaldorei prize discretion when dealing with corruption so close to their heartlands. Melenas' Head is private proof that his schemes have ended before his influence could spread.
